class T(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_case(self):
        class It():
            def __init__(me, data): me.data = data
            def __iter__(me): return iter(me.data)
        src = [3, 1, 2]
        u = It(src)
        self.assertEqual(list(u), [3, 1, 2])
        u2 = It(src)
        self.assertEqual(sorted(u2), [1, 2, 3])
        u3 = It(src)
        self.assertEqual(tuple(u3), (3, 1, 2))
        u4 = It(src)
        self.assertEqual(dict.fromkeys(It(['a', 'b'])), {'a': None, 'b': None})
        u5 = It([1, 2])
        self.assertEqual(sum(u5), 3)
        u6 = It([True, False])
        self.assertEqual(any(u6), True)
        u7 = It([True, 1])
        self.assertEqual(all(u7), True)
        u8 = It([4, 2, 9])
        self.assertEqual(max(u8), 9)
        u9 = It([4, 2, 9])
        self.assertEqual(min(u9), 2)
        u10 = It([1, 2])
        self.assertEqual(list(enumerate(u10)), [(0, 1), (1, 2)])
        u11 = It([1, 2])
        self.assertEqual(list(zip(u11, 'ab')), [(1, 'a'), (2, 'b')])

class T(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_case(self):
        big = 10 ** 400
        inf = float('inf')
        ninf = float('-inf')
        self.assertEqual(inf > big, True)
        self.assertEqual(big < inf, True)
        self.assertEqual(ninf < -big, True)
        self.assertEqual(-big > ninf, True)
        self.assertEqual(big > 1e308, True)

cases.name: pin-item20-dynamic-slice-read-del
cases.src:
class T(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_case(self):
        xs = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
        s = slice(1, 5, 2)
        self.assertEqual(xs[s], [1, 3])
        d = slice(0, 2)
        del xs[d]
        self.assertEqual(xs, [2, 3, 4, 5])
